deviations.remediation: Driver measured that in THIS app Filament resolves 'primary' 500 and 'warning' 500 to the byte-identical oklch(0.769 0.188 70.08) (= Tailwind amber-500), with no custom palette registered. So the gate-time recommendation of 'primary' was worse than described: the card renders the SAME as the two staging-hit cards, not merely close. Surfaced with the measurement; operator chose to keep 'primary' and align the sparkline to amber, accepting that the three cards look alike, rather than add a 9th file to register a custom colour.

deviations.why: CORRECTS A DRIVER ERROR. The driver told the operator that 'primary' and 'warning' resolve to a byte-identical colour, measured via FilamentColor::getColors() in tinker. That is WRONG for the rendered page -- tinker reads framework defaults outside a panel request. Agent QA measured the real DOM: primary = oklch(0.704 0.187 23.186) = rgb(255,102,102) (red), warning = oklch(0.828 0.189 84.429) = rgb(255,185,0) (amber). Both screenshots confirm. The operator's Q3 decision ('keep primary, make the sparkline amber to match') was therefore taken on bad information; the amber sparkline did NOT match, leaving one card drawn in two colours (red compact, amber expanded). Operator reconfirmed 'consistent' after being shown the measurement, so the sparkline now matches the rendered primary.
